contexts.text: At the end of the sixth day the evil Spirits recede.
Being ashamed, he receded.
That He should recede from the things of the external man. Signified.
Then the things of the cupidity of evil and of the persuasion of falsity recede.
After regeneration, these things recede.
When the Societies... which are in middle good recede...
Societies do not easily recede... and when he with whom they are recedes, they are indignant.
The separation of Spirits of a middle sort is effected by many means, until they recede in freedom. Explained.
Recession from the scientifics of the Church. Signified, Explained.
In this state they recede from celestial and spiritual things... This occultation, or recession, is not effected by the Lord's hiding Himself, or receding; but by themselves doing so.
Therefore the Angels recede as the infernal Spirits approach nearer (to the man); yet the Angels... never recede completely...
They (then) easily recede from faith about the resurrection.
The recession thence. Signified. AC 6401.
That they would recede from infestation. Signified.
Then the Angels and good Spirits recede by degrees from them; and, as they recede, they become less and less rational.
The recession and separation of the communication with those in good and truth. Signified, Explained.
Recession still further. Signified.
The Spirits of (Saturn) recede from the natural sense in man, and accede to the spiritual.
The breast-plate shall not depart from upon the ephod () = all things of Heaven inseparable from the externals of the Spiritual Kingdom.
They have departed suddenly from the way which I have commanded them () = that they have removed themselves from Divine truth.
They can (then) with difficulty recede from these things.
So often did my delight recede.
They thus recede from a holy external, and come into a holy internal.
The Divine mercy... never recedes from anyone.
As these fears recede...
These substances recede when man dies.
That if man afterwards recedes... he profanes holy things. Explained. DP 227:3. DP 231:7. AR 202:2.
Man would (then) recede from good.
That all the good of love and truth of faith had receded. Signified, Explained.
Lest I should disturb them, I withdrew.
That still they do not recede from falsities... and evils. Signified. AR 710.
Faith which... departs from the true faith.
If God is not received, He does not withdraw...
The rod of Egypt shall depart (). Explained.
The streams shall depart () = that all things of spiritual intelligence will go away... To depart, etc., = to perish.
By recession (this) is profaned.
This recession is described here.
